Name: Rat-catcher's Shack
Special Rules: The first time you collect income from this holding you ransack it: collect the ransack loot, then replace it with a Ruined Hovel (no income from that Ruined Hovel until the following aftermath sequence).

Name: Intact Town House
Special Rules: The first time you collect income from this holding you ransack it: collect the ransack loot, then replace it with a Ruined Hovel (no income from that Ruined Hovel until the following aftermath sequence).

Name: Dilapidated Guild Shoppe
Extra Rewards: Roll once on the Curiosities table
Special Rules: The first time you collect income from this holding you ransack it: collect the ransack loot, then replace it with a Ruined Hovel (no income from that Ruined Hovel until the following aftermath sequence).

Name: Burnt Down Smithy
Extra Rewards: Roll d6: 1-2 add d3 Daggers to your stash; 3-4 add d3 Shields to your stash; 5-6 add d3 Swords to your stash
Special Rules: The first time you collect income from this holding you ransack it: collect the ransack loot, then replace it with a Ruined Hovel (no income from that Ruined Hovel until the following aftermath sequence).

Name: Old Tavern
Extra Rewards: Every fighter in your warband earns 5 bonus experience
Special Rules: Drink Deep: When you ransack this holding, every fighter in your warband earns 5 bonus experience. The first time you collect income from this holding you ransack it: collect the ransack loot, then replace it with a Ruined Hovel (no income from that Ruined Hovel until the following aftermath sequence).

Name: Moneylender's House
Special Rules: The first time you collect income from this holding you ransack it: collect the ransack loot, then replace it with a Ruined Hovel (no income from that Ruined Hovel until the following aftermath sequence).

Name: Jewelsmith
Special Rules: The first time you collect income from this holding you ransack it: collect the ransack loot, then replace it with a Ruined Hovel (no income from that Ruined Hovel until the following aftermath sequence).

Name: Eel-farm
Special Rules: Run Dry: If the d6 roll to determine the income is a 1, the supply of eels runs out. After the income is collected, this holding becomes a Ruined Hovel.

Name: Tainted Well
Special Rules: Drink Unclean Waters: Once in step 6 of the aftermath sequence, a fighter can drink from the well. If they do so, you can remove 1 of their temporary injuries, but they gain 1 level of Black Rot.

Name: Ruined Tower
Special Rules: Spy the City: This holding grants 1 exploration re-roll when the controlling warband explores the City.

Name: Collapsed Mine
Special Rules: Depleted: If the d6 roll to determine the income is a 1, the remaining tunnels are exhausted. After the income is collected, this holding is removed.

Name: Leechmonger
Extra Rewards: 1 Jar of Canal Leeches each time you collect income
Special Rules: Fresh from the Canals: Each time you collect income from this holding, you receive 1 Jar of Canal Leeches.

Name: Old Cemetery
Extra Rewards: If any 6 is rolled on the income dice, roll once on the Curiosity table
Special Rules: Grave Digging: Each time you collect income from this holding, if you roll one or more 6's you can roll on the Curiosity Table.

Name: Herbalist's Shoppe
Extra Rewards: 1 Healing Tonic each time you collect income
Special Rules: Apothecary's Wares: Each time you collect income from this holding, you receive 1 Healing Tonic.

Name: Auction House
Extra Rewards: Selling a Curiosity: +d6 silver; selling a Relic: +2d6 silver
Special Rules: "Going, Going, Gone": Whenever you sell a Curiosity you receive an additional d6 silver. Whenever you sell a Relic you receive an additional 2d6 silver.

Name: Insidious Alchemist
Extra Rewards: Each income collection roll d6: 1 nothing; 2 Tonic of Speed; 3 Tonic of Strength; 4 Tonic of Fortitude; 5 Blinding Powder; 6 Alchemist's Fire
Special Rules: Alchemists' Wares: Each time you collect income from this holding, roll a dice on the table: 1 You receive nothing extra. 2 You receive 1 Tonic of Speed. 3 You receive 1 Tonic of Strength. 4 You receive 1 Tonic of Fortitude. 5 You receive 1 Blinding Powder. 6 You receive 1 Alchemist's Fire.

Name: Catacombs Tunnel
Special Rules: Arrival by Tunnel: Once per battle, when a fighter from the warband that controls this holding gets the Outflank result on the reinforcement table, they can emerge from the tunnels. If they do so, set up the fighter anywhere on the battlefield floor, more than 6" from all enemy fighters.

Name: Saint's Well
Special Rules: Drink Pure Waters: Once in step 6 of the aftermath sequence, a fighter can drink from the well. If they do so, you can remove 1 of their temporary injuries. The Water Blackens: If the income roll for this territory is a triple (eg. a 3d6 roll of 4, 4, 4), after the income is collected, this holding becomes a Tainted Well.

Name: Blackdrop Widow
Extra Rewards: d3 Vials of Poison each time you collect income
Special Rules: Poisonous Wares: Each time you collect income from this holding, you receive d3 Vials of Poison.

Name: Merchant's Warehouse
Special Rules: Discovered: If the income roll for this territory is a double (eg. a 2d6 roll of 4 and 4), after the income is collected, this holding becomes a Ruined Hovel.

Name: Ye Olde Curiosity Shoppe
Extra Rewards: Roll once on the Curiosity Table each time you collect income
Special Rules: Curious Wares: Each time you collect income from this holding you can roll once on the Curiosity Table.

Name: Silver Mine
Special Rules: Hiring Workers: You cannot collect income from this territory until you have hired workers. Hiring workers costs 10 silver and is done once in step 6 of the aftermath sequence. Once workers are hired, income can be collected from the following aftermath sequence onwards. Make a note on your warband roster. If another warband gains control of this holding, the workers need to be hired once more. Collapse: If the income roll for this territory is a triple (eg. a 3d6 roll of 4, 4, 4), after the income is collected, this holding becomes a Collapsed Mine.

Name: Wizard's Tower
Special Rules: The Trials of the Tower: When a warband first takes control of this holding, it has 3 wards remaining. During the campaign, keep track of how many wards remain on this holding, including if another warband takes control of this holding. Once in step 6 of the aftermath sequence, the warband that controls this holding can send its Leader or a Champion to attempt to bypass a ward. If they do so, make a Willpower test for that fighter. If passed, 1 ward is removed from the holding. If failed, make an injury roll for the fighter. When all wards have been removed, the warband that controls this holding claims its treasure. They roll once on the Relic table. Then, this Holding becomes a Ruined Tower.
